geeklist.title: Winter Mystery Box Auction - ends 12/7
geeklist.description:
Hello! Would you like to buy a box full of games you don't already have? Want a big box of surprises to land on your doorstep? I've put together several Mystery Boxes for your perusal.
Don't want a whole box, but still want a surprise? I've also posted three levels of single-game options at the end of the auction list. These single game options have a flat price which [COLOR=#FF0000]includes shipping[/COLOR]! I'm happy to ship items to your Secret Santa target and make sure they aren't receiving a duplicate game as well.
Please read the details below carefully.
* [b]NO DUPLICATES[/b]. If you win one of the lots in this auction, I will check your rated, owned and previously-owned games to make sure I don't send you anything that you own or don't want anymore. If that removes any games, I will substitute a game meeting the same guidelines. If that's not possible, I'll message you to offer you the lot at a proportional price. If you don't want it, it will go to the next highest bidder.
* [b]NO DUDS[/b]. Games in this auction have an average BGG rating of 6.0 and above unless otherwise stated. Most of them are far above that threshold. See the individual lot descriptions for more info. In general, I'm trying to increase the amount of fun in the world, not foist awful games off on other people.
* [b]GREAT CONDITION[/b]. These games are all complete and nearly all are in very good condition or better. I will describe the condition of anything that's not.
* [b]BIN BONUS #1[/b] - [b][COLOR=#FF0000]FREE GAME[/COLOR][/b]. Use Buy-It-Now with any box that has a BIN option and I will throw in an additional game. These will also meet the conditions above (no duplicates, no duds and great condition).
* [b]BIN BONUS #2[/b] - [b][COLOR=#FF0000]ANOTHER FREEBIE[/COLOR][/b]. Use Buy-It-Now with any box that has a BIN option and I will throw in an additional game-related item. These will occasionally be small or micro-games or games with a rating below 6.0. Others might be promos, storage helpers, etc. Temper your expectations and you will be pleasantly surprised.
* [b]BIN BONUS #3[/b] - [b][COLOR=#FF0000]SHARED SHIPPING[/COLOR][/b]. US buyers who use Buy-It-Now will pay only 75% of the USPS shipping cost. I will cover the rest.
Boring stuff:
1. Bids in whole US dollars.
2. Auction will end around 7:30 pm on Sunday, December 7th (Pacific Time).
3. Pickup and dropoff in the 97219 area (SW Portland) are available -- message me.
4. BGG gets their 3%. Sales will go through the Marketplace.
Thanks to Alison Mandible and Brad Keusch for the inspiration and auction descriptions.
Feel free to ask questions if you have them!

item.comment:
All of the games in this lot are in very good condition or better. I have indicated when items are like new. Five of the games are unplayed by me.
:d10-1: The first game in this lot is owned by less than 10 users in the US. In Like New condition, with the cards still in the shrink. There are no other copies available in the US marketplace. Fans say "Surprisingly clever mechanisms" and "Even nicer components!"
:d10-2: The second game in this lot is owned by less than 15 users in the US. There are no other copies available in the US marketplace. Fans say "Awesome! Awesome! Awesome! I love everything about it! This will be a new favorite! Great components!"
:d10-3: The third game in this lot is owned by less than 25 users in the US. There are no other copies available in the BGG marketplace (even internationally). Fans say "An inexplicably delicious meal", "Unlike any game I've ever played" and "The theme is strong with this one."
:d10-4: The fourth game in this lot is a rare imported copy of a classic game. There are no other copies of this edition available in the US marketplace. Fans say "Truly outstanding. Probably my favorite game anywhere, ever." Rated 10 by over 1000 BGG users.
:d10-5: The fifth game in this lot is new in shrink. It is the only NIS copy available in the US marketplace (there is one used copy available). Fans say "Extraordinarily well designed and balanced game" and "Great addition to my collection."
:d10-6: The sixth game in this lot is a unique hybrid. There are only two copies available in the US Marketplace. Fans say "The bits are top notch" and "Great game and so very, very beautiful."
